summary: This React component adds a special link tag to a blog post's HTML head that points to a plain-Markdown version of the article. It helps tools and crawlers discover that a Markdown mirror exists at a predictable URL (the article's permalink with .md appended), similar to how RSS feeds are discovered.

explanations.8: This imports JSX.Element, which is TypeScript's way of saying 'this function returns something that looks like React/JSX code'.
explanations.9: This imports Docusaurus's Head component, which lets you inject tags directly into the HTML <head> section of the page.
explanations.10: This hook gives us access to the current blog post's metadata (like its URL path) that Docusaurus provides.
explanations.13: We're destructuring to pull out just the metadata object from the hook — this contains things like the permalink (the URL) of the current article.
explanations.20: We're constructing the URL to the Markdown mirror by taking the article's permalink and appending .md to the end.
